head: Eight calls,
one order
body: The store writes the record, then publishes the key with putIfAbsent. The loser returns the winner's order.
A test fires eight concurrent createOrder calls with one key and asserts a single order id.

head: Make the retry

body: The backend is in-memory, so dedup is process-local. I haven't traced a retry after a hard decline.
